def preprocess(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return " ".join(

    return ""

        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=2000,
        random_state=42,
        multi_class="auto",
        class_weight="balanced",
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train[:, col_idx])
    models[col_idx] = clf

    val_probs_all[:, col_idx] = probs

    val_auc_scores.append(auc)
